review.description: The layered registry dependency direction, stable gap IDs and pinned adoption policy remain unchanged. New behavior is declared with code and actual test assertions.
review.implementation: Reviewed new source mappings, scenario S4 graphs, widget instances, element terms and console endpoints. No consuming specification backlinks were added to glossary definitions and no adoption exception was extended.
review.tests: Deterministic render/validate and mapped tooling suites exercise the new registries. The runner inputs already include internal/web source trees so the new helper/provider files invalidate prior verification.
